what: Each time you hover a link, the next of six handwritten underline shapes is drawn from the left in .5s, and on release it is erased toward the end of the drawing direction in .5s. Releasing mid-draw finishes drawing, then erases. The current-page link (keep) is drawn in .6s as soon as it loads

options.keep: When true, it draws the line right on attach and keeps it (current page menu · always-underlined links)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Where the underline goes. If none, one is built under the link sized to the text

use: Menu 1 · Current page: data-fx-squiggle-hover="keep: true"

from.where: shared.js drawLines (menu · footer links [data-draw-line] — original cycles 6 handwritten SVGs, enter .5s · exit 100% 100% .5s power2.inOut, persist·always .6s)

note: Shapes do not use the original artwork — they were redrawn with the same length (310×40) and feel. The shape order is shared by the whole page as one rotation (like the original, each link gets the next shape)
